prompt: A vertical 9:16 linocut print in two inks only, black and a hot vermilion red, on off-white rough rag paper with gouge marks and uneven ink. Bold parallel lines for the desk grain, the red printed a few millimetres out of register, like a hand-pulled proof. Thanks.
